# Primary-target reward-to-risk screening

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED -->
## Definition

Entry methodology sets a Moderate-profile floor of 1.5:1 gross reward-to-risk to the first realistic target and 1.5:1 net when costs are supplied. A distant Target 2 cannot rescue Target 1. Conservative entry, executable stop and attainable target are needed; unknown costs are not zero. Hold methodology uses remaining economics from the dated reference price as a guide, without manufacturing a tighter stop.[^stock-entry-strategy-5-instructions-51bfbec68204b2d3][^stock-entry-strategy-10-instructions-b62891c31dd14f64][^stock-hold-strategy-5-instructions-d8721315f9cdba99][^stock-hold-strategy-10-instructions-d9a1481b76debebd]

## Report-level applications

ICBP’s September 25 5dd entry report preserves the upstream hypothetical 1.70:1 to the second target, but rejects its first-target 0.85:1 structure. HRTA’s best-supported 2,260 entry offers only 0.58:1 to first target 2,370 and 1.11:1 even to 2,470; the wide 2,070 risk boundary is not tightened by invention.[^icbp-be4bae821fb86c38][^hrta-e2f2954f5612304b]

BULL 5dd shows provisional 1.75:1 economics at 384/376/398, yet rejects entry for calendar, liquidity and undefined-trigger defects. The 10dd candidate at 402 against 380 gives only 0.09:1–0.59:1 to its first zone. The two horizons are not blended into one payoff.[^bull-a75efdaf022b83d5][^bull-1b5fbb4a82ee07a0]

BNBR’s conditional 10dd support entry uses worst entry 82, risk reference 76 and target 91 for exactly 1.50:1 gross. The report makes entry conditional on verified net economics; it does not establish a fill. Its alternative 84 breakout fails at 0.875:1.[^bnbr-694cd85cde8d5c1b]

The binary break-even calculation is not a predicted win rate, and it does not model partial exits, time exits or gaps.[^stock-entry-strategy-5-instructions-51bfbec68204b2d3][^stock-entry-strategy-10-instructions-b62891c31dd14f64]

> Synthesis: Passing arithmetic is one gate among several. A ratio cannot repair missing freshness, trigger evidence, tradability or a defensible stop.
